so_sdk.interface: async def read_stream(manifest: Manifest, stream: str, tenant_id: str, cursor: str | None, budget: Budget) -> Page  # Page = {records[], next_cursor, acl_raw}
so_sdk.code:
async def read_stream(m, stream, tenant, cursor, rate, vault, http, hooks):
    s = m.stream(stream)
    host = urlparse(s.base_url).hostname
    if host not in m.host_allowlist:            # manifest cannot point at arbitrary hosts
        raise HostNotAllowed(host)
    token = await vault.token_for(tenant, m.app)
    page_size = s.page_size or 100
    grant = await rate.acquire(tenant, m.app, s.path, cost=1, priority='backfill' if cursor is None else 'live')
    resp = await http.get(s.base_url + s.path, headers={'Authorization': f'Bearer {token}'},
                          params=s.paginator.params(cursor, page_size), timeout=30)
    if resp.status_code == 429:
        rate.penalise(tenant, m.app, s.path, retry_after=int(resp.headers.get('Retry-After', 1)))
        raise Throttled()
    body = resp.json()
    records = s.record_selector(body)
    acl = [s.acl_mapping.apply(r) for r in records] if s.acl_mapping else []
    if m.hooks.get(stream):                     # only when the manifest names one
        records = hooks.run(m.hooks[stream], records, timeout=30)
    nxt = s.paginator.next_cursor(body, resp)
    # the cursor is NOT saved here; the caller saves it after the batch is committed downstream
    return Page(records=records, next_cursor=nxt, acl_raw=acl)

so_rate.interface: async def acquire(tenant_id: str, app_id: str, endpoint: str, cost: float = 1, priority: str = 'live') -> Grant  # {tokens, wait_ms} or raises Denied{reason, retry_after_ms}
so_rate.code:
-- bucket.lua  KEYS[1]=child KEYS[2]=parent  ARGV: now_ms cost rate burst prate pburst share is_backfill
local function refill(key, now, rate, burst)
  local t = tonumber(redis.call('HGET', key, 'tokens') or burst)
  local ts = tonumber(redis.call('HGET', key, 'ts_ms') or now)
  return math.min(burst, t + rate * (now - ts) / 1000.0)
end
local now, cost = tonumber(ARGV[1]), tonumber(ARGV[2])
local paused = tonumber(redis.call('HGET', KEYS[1], 'paused_until_ms') or 0)
if paused > now then return {0, paused - now} end            -- honour Retry-After
local c = refill(KEYS[1], now, tonumber(ARGV[3]), tonumber(ARGV[4]))
local p = refill(KEYS[2], now, tonumber(ARGV[5]), tonumber(ARGV[6]))
local reserve = 0
if ARGV[8] == '1' then reserve = tonumber(ARGV[6]) * (1 - tonumber(ARGV[7])) end -- backfill leaves the live share untouched
if c >= cost and p - cost >= reserve then
  redis.call('HSET', KEYS[1], 'tokens', c - cost, 'ts_ms', now)
  redis.call('HSET', KEYS[2], 'tokens', p - cost, 'ts_ms', now)
  return {1, 0}
end
redis.call('HSET', KEYS[1], 'tokens', c, 'ts_ms', now)
redis.call('HSET', KEYS[2], 'tokens', p, 'ts_ms', now)
local need = math.max(cost - c, cost - p)
return {0, math.ceil(need / tonumber(ARGV[3]) * 1000)}

so_mcp.interface: async def call_tool(tenant_id: str, user_id: str, app_id: str, tool: str, arguments: dict, deadline_ms: int) -> ToolResult  # {items[{native_id,title,snippet,url,modified_at}], truncated, ms} | error {timeout|denied|upstream_down}
so_mcp.code:
import asyncio, hashlib, json, time

async def call_tool(req, obo, rate, pins, session_factory, audit):
    t0 = time.monotonic()
    budget = min(3.0, req.deadline_ms / 1000)                  # per-source deadline
    pin = pins.get(req.app_id)
    token = await obo.exchange(user=req.user_id, app=req.app_id, resource=pin.server_url)
    await rate.acquire(req.tenant_id, req.app_id, 'mcp:' + req.tool, 1, 'live')
    try:
        async with session_factory(pin.server_url, token) as s:
            live = await asyncio.wait_for(s.list_tools(), timeout=budget)
            names = sorted(t.name for t in live.tools)
            if hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(names).encode()).hexdigest() != pin.tools_hash:
                audit(req, 'pin_mismatch'); return Err('denied')   # tool list changed: do not call
            if req.tool not in pin.allowed_tools:
                return Err('denied')
            left = budget - (time.monotonic() - t0)
            res = await asyncio.wait_for(s.call_tool(req.tool, req.arguments), timeout=max(left, 0.1))
    except asyncio.TimeoutError:
        audit(req, 'timeout'); return Err('timeout')          # never partial text as success
    items = parse_items(res)[:10]
    audit(req, 'ok', n=len(items))
    return ToolResult(items=items, truncated=len(items) == 10, ms=int((time.monotonic() - t0) * 1000))
